**Vibe coded with Claude.** The code was written by AI (Anthropic's Claude) and tested by a human on a real phone. Expect rough edges, and please report bugs in Issues.

## Install

1. Download **EclipseReader-unsigned.ipa** below.
2. Sideload it with AltStore, SideStore, Sideloadly, Signulous or your usual signing tool.
3. Settings › About shows the version, build number and commit, so you can tell which build you're running.

Runs on iPhone, iPad and the iPhone Duo (folded and unfolded), iOS 17 or later.

## Highlights

- Manga right to left with page curl; manhwa, manhua and webtoons as one vertical strip; comics left to right.
- 51 built-in sources in Browse, plus your own sites and source lists.
- On-device scan enhancer: whiter paper, blacker ink, less JPEG noise, small scans upscaled to your screen. Hold two fingers on a page to compare.
- One search across every site: results arrive as each site answers, the same series is shown once, and sites that keep failing can be turned off in one tap.
- "Because you read" recommendations from AniList, matched to the kind of series you read.
- Page slider preview with two pages either side, chapters marked read at their last page, Pairs for split spreads, rotation lock.
- Downloads, updates with notifications, history, AniList tracking, CBZ/CBR/PDF import, backups. No analytics or tracking.

The app doesn't host or store any manga itself: pages load straight from the sites you read, like a browser.
